Consult Summary:
- Patient presents with headaches associated with work, along with intermittent palpitations, shortness of breath, arm tingling, reduced appetite with a small amount of weight loss, and decreased libido; history of hyperthyroidism on thyroxine; plan to evaluate with in-person examination and thyroid function testing; appointment to be booked via the app.

History:

- Timeline: Symptoms began roughly after changing jobs; ongoing and affecting work performance; headaches occur during work (meetings or laptop use); weight loss noticed since this change; decreased libido reported since job change.
- Severity/impact: Work performance affected; stress level around 7–8/10.
- Exposures/triggers: Symptoms commonly occur at work; some symptoms occur with elevator use and desk computer work.
- Associated symptoms: Nausea with headaches; shortness of breath; tingling in arms; lip or facial numbness not described; no clear fever reported, but patient mentions feeling hot.
- Symptoms by system:
  - Neurologic: Bilateral arm tingling; no leg tingling.
  - Cardiopulmonary: Palpitations (rapid heart rate); occasional dyspnea at desk; no exercise-induced dyspnea.
  - Constitutional/other: Decreased appetite; weight loss of ~5 lb; decreased libido.
- Relevant negatives mentioned: No prior headaches before health changes; no leg tingling; no detailed focal neurological deficits described.
